subject: Urgent: Missed remittance — proposed remediation & leadership touchpoint
messages:
From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novaredata.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-29 10:03 AM
Subject: Overdue: Invoice ND-2028-05 (remittance not received)

Hi Soojin,

We're following up on Invoice ND-2028-05 (EUR 128,450, due 2028-05-15). Our treasury shows no successful remittance. Can you confirm receipt on your side? We've paused usage a little while ago per our internal policy and need to resolve this to restore access.

Quick context: the payment was initiated from our UK entity but got routed through an internal intermediary, and our bank flagged a beneficiary mismatch. Finance asked us to confirm local bank instructions and VAT breakdown before retrying.

Please advise by EOD — if there's anything we need to provide (revised invoice, local account, or pro forma), we'll get it over immediately.

Regards,
Amanda Li
Head of Finance – NovareData
[Attachment: Novare_invoice_ND-2028-05.pdf (pdf, 92KB)]

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novaredata.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-29 11:12 AM
Subject: Re: Overdue: Invoice ND-2028-05 (remittance not received)

Hi Amanda — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice. I'm sorry for the interruption.

Immediate plan:
- I will have Finance publish a local EU bank account and a pro forma copy of the invoice with the VAT line item by EOD today.
- We can also generate a one-click payment link (SEPA/ACH compatible) to make retrying simpler for your team.
- To avoid service disruption while funds clear, we can waive the standard late fee for this payment if Novare confirms the wire attempt and commits to remitting within 72 hours.

I'll loop in our collections and legal leads to make this fast — copying Kimberly (collections lead). Can you confirm whether your payment will be a single wire or split across entities? That will help us format the beneficiary details.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-30 09:05 AM
Subject: NovareData ND-2028-05 — escalation options (need leadership opt-in)

Team — Novare's wire failed because of intercompany routing. External said they'll retry if we provide local EU banking details and a VAT breakdown. They paused service; we should keep the product on for 24–72 hours while they resolve.

Options to propose to the customer (pick 1):
A) Technical unblock only: provide local bank + pro forma, waive late fee once we see evidence of attempted payment. No credits. Expected collection window: 72 hours.
B) Finance concession: provide local bank + one-time 5% service credit if funds are received within 48 hours (ask legal to draft short approval).
C) Commercial uplift: offer an expedited payment plan (2 installments, 30/60) in exchange for a 12-month commitment extension and 10% credit — requires leadership sign-off.

Recommend starting with A to avoid setting precedent, escalate to B if Novare shows proof of an attempted wire but needs a push. If we go C we should involve Sales Ops to formalize contract amendment — that will be a heavier lift.

Please advise by 12:00 so I can respond to Amanda.

Soojin

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-30 10:20 AM
Subject: Re: NovareData ND-2028-05 — escalation options (need leadership opt-in)

Agree start with A. Two operational notes:
- Collections ops can add a dedicated EU IBAN on a pro forma invoice within 2 business hours — request from Soojin to operations now.
- Add a short dunning step (email with pay link + copy to finance) before product enforcement; clears a lot of false-positives and is low cost.

If we get proof of attempted wire but still no clear ETA, escalate to B — a 5% credit buys a lot of good will and is a low-dollar lever here. I do NOT recommend C unless we see churn risk tied to long-term commitment.

Jonas
VP, Revenue Strategy

From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novaredata.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NovareData Billing <finance@novaredata.com>
Date: 2028-06-01 14:46 PM
Subject: Re: Overdue: Invoice ND-2028-05 (remittance not received)

Thanks — we investigated with our bank. The attempted wire reflected the correct amount but was blocked because the intermediary rejected the beneficiary name formatting (our treasury team uses a central payments hub that normalizes payees). We can re-initiate immediately if you provide: 1) a local EU IBAN/beneficiary name format, and 2) a pro forma with VAT line.

We will attempt again within 72 hours once those documents are received. Attached is a screenshot of the failed SWIFT trace for your records.

Amanda
Head of Finance — NovareData
[Attachment: payment_evidence_SWIFT_20280601.png (png, 38KB)]

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novaredata.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-02 08:30 AM
Subject: Re: Overdue: Invoice ND-2028-05 (remittance not received) — action confirmed

Amanda — thank you for the trace.

Action items completed: 
- Collections has produced a pro forma with VAT separated and the beneficiary as "Redwood Inference EU Operations" plus local IBAN (sent to you via secure link).
- We generated a SEPA payment link and added it to the invoice PDF.
- As a one-off operational accommodation, we will waive the late fee for ND-2028-05 provided we receive evidence of the re-initiated wire within 72 hours. If funds are received, we'll confirm service restoration immediately.

Internal: Kimberly & Laura, please: 1) upload the pro forma to the HubSpot record (link below), 2) schedule the 15-min leadership check-in tomorrow 16:00 CEST to confirm whether to offer a 5% credit if the payment still stalls after 72 hours.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/NovareData

Soojin Lee
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
